_note: Pre-registered S4 demand-trajectory basket (amendment A5, 2026-06-12, analysis/preregistered_signals.md). The signal adjudicates GROWTH, not LEVEL: composition is fixed at registration so a hostile reader disputes the trajectory, not the baseline. Company-stated run-rate prints only -- no analyst estimates, no interpolation. Known level double-counts (Microsoft's AI figure includes Azure-OpenAI consumption and cloud-resold Anthropic API) bias the LEVEL, and growth too if the double-counted component compounds faster -- carded as a caveat, not silently netted. Re-card on every new company print; additions to composition only via the amendment log.

basket_definition.exclusions: Google/Alphabet excluded: no company-disclosed AI revenue run-rate exists as of 2026-06 (Q1-2026 earnings disclose cloud growth and backlog but no AI-attributed dollar figure).
basket_definition.semantics: S4 = trailing YoY growth of the basket total vs the bull's required path; thresholds registered in src/bubble/market_signals.py and analysis/preregistered_signals.md.

baskets.caveats: Baseline carded retroactively on 2026-06-12 (the thresholds are ex-ante; the baseline is sourced measurement of the past). Anthropic mid-2025 print has the weakest sourcing in the file; Microsoft mid-2025 is IMPLIED from the company's own +123% YoY statement, not a disclosure.

All three are company-self-reported, unaudited run-rates. Anthropic's $9B(end-2025)->$47B(May-2026) slope is the least independently verifiable datum in the basket. OpenAI 'past $25B' June S-1 coverage is journalistic synthesis; the $2B/month (=$24B annualized) March company statement is used instead.
